senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. שָׁלֵו, a. שָׁלָה)to be lax, hang down, be loose, slip. Denom. שָׁלִיף.
to loosen, take off, pull, draw a sword.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>יִשְׁלוֹף</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ישמוט</he>) may he loosen (release), v. <cite ref="H01109"><he>חָלַץ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:5:2">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᶜ</cite> top (ref. to <cite ref="Ruth 4:7">Ruth IV, 7</cite>) <he>מי ש׳</he> which took the shoe off (the buyer or the seller)? <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:1">Num. R. s. 14<sup>4</sup></cite> <he>מסמר … נוח לִשְׁלוֹף</he> a nail with a big head is easily pulled; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 120:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXX</cite> <he>אם יִשְׁלוֹף האדם וכ׳</he> if a man draws the sword which he has in his hand to slay his neighbor &c.; a. e.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93">Gen. R. s. 93</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 150:2">Yalk. ib. 150</cite> <he>ואינה נִשְׁלֶפֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="V00793"><he>תַּעַר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 32:1-5">Yalk. ib. 32</cite> <he>על … שאדם מַשְׁלִיף שדהו אוכלה וכ׳</he> this (<cite ref="Genesis 3:18">Gen. III, 18</cite>) was said with reference to these days, when one plucks his field over and again and eats it (the aftermath) &c., v.
